problem: LibreCAD_3 interpreted MPOLYGON offset-space boundary coordinates as drawing coordinates and projected the subtype and polygon fields to HATCH. The pinned older libdxfrw also applies HATCH group 70/71 meanings to DXF MPOLYGON.

primaryEvidence.title: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbMPolygon::getOffsetVector
primaryEvidence.interpretation: The reference describes stored boundaries in offset space, with the offset subtracted from actual vertices. The adapter adds this offset back in the polygon OCS. Non-default outer elevation/extrusion remains warned because full OCS-to-editing-plane conversion is not implemented.

change: Map MPOLYGON offsets onto polyline vertices, line endpoints, arc and ellipse centers, and spline control/fit points, while leaving vectors and ordinary HATCH paths unchanged. Reject non-finite offset sums through the existing guarded import failure.
For DXF imported with the pinned old codec, interpret the forwarded group-71 value as the MPOLYGON solid flag. DWG retains that codec's normal solid flag.

Retain a source snapshot for a limited, nonassociative, solid, single closed-polyline profile in the default plane, without retained object references, proxy, XDATA or data storage. On a compatible codec, unchanged and exactly translated geometry is written as MPOLYGON; a planar translation updates its offset. Richer or differently edited polygons fall back to HATCH with an export loss note.
Never replay using the older codec: its MPOLYGON group-70/71 serialization is incompatible. If required target fields cannot be carried, retain the reported fallback.

downstream.status: Both patches are local and unmerged; apply in listed order to the consumer source. No user checkout changed.

validation.environment: macOS ARM64, Apple clang 21; temporary consumer CMake integration selecting installed static archives
validation.consumerTests: 9/9 tests pass, consisting of eight existing tests plus one from-scratch DXF regression, for each library version. The regression exercises ASCII and binary, exact offset mapping, line/arc/ellipse/spline points, ordinary HATCH negative control, translation, rotation and Z edit fallbacks, retry after restoring geometry, multi-loop fallback, old-codec solid flag, non-default-plane warning, finite-overflow failure and clean subsequent import, and version/gradient target guards.
validation.generatedDwgControls: A separate three-test scratch probe using a locally generated AC1018 drawing passes with both libraries; with the new library it exercises MPOLYGON ASCII/Binary roundtrip, translation and readback. The older library uses the reported HATCH fallback.

independentPeer.name: ezdxf
independentPeer.observations: Reads MPOLYGON from generated-DWG-to-DXF ASCII and binary; each has one closed three-vertex path, fill ACI 3 and offset (2,5). After a planar (10,0) edit, reads offset (12,5) with original stored vertices. This checks tags and geometry representation, not native rendering.

validation.patchApplication: Both patches pass sequential git apply --check on an archive of the exact consumer base.

limits: Patches are not merged or integrated into official LibreCAD_3; no native UI execution, Windows, Linux, or released-build qualification.

Only the selected simple default-plane profile replays as MPOLYGON. Rotation, nonplanar edits, multiple paths, legacy serializer, and other unsupported states use reported fallback; actual 3D plane transformation is not implemented.
The peer confirms emitted tags, not native CAD rendering, arbitrary producer data, graph closure, or full field fidelity. No broad support or phase gate is promoted.
